panel.title: Cost per passenger

general.name: Trip name
general.currencyHelp: All costs and prices are entered in this currency.
general.budgetedHelp: How many people the group costs are split between. Coordinators aren't included, since they aren't charged.
general.coordinatorHelp: Their accommodation goes in as a group cost, not as a passenger cost.
general.passportMonthsHelp: How long the passport must stay valid after the return date.
general.requireFullValidityHelp: Turn this on if the destination requires it on entry, like the Schengen area. Without it, it's only a warning.

itinerary.empty: You haven't added any destinations yet. Start with the first one.

itinerary.noHotels: No hotels added for this destination.

directCosts.intro: What each passenger is charged: dinners, tickets, trains. Enter the amount per person.
directCosts.empty: You haven't added any meals or events yet.

indirectCosts.intro: What's paid once for the whole group: the charter, transfers, the coordinators' accommodation. Enter the total and the system splits it.
indirectCosts.empty: You haven't added any group costs yet.

prices.intro: The system works out the cost. You set the price: the difference is the margin.
prices.basisConfirmed: Based on the {count} confirmed passengers ({double} sharing, {single} in single rooms)
prices.basisScenarioDouble: If all {count} travel in shared rooms
prices.basisScenarioSingle: If all {count} travel in single rooms
prices.noConfirmedYet: No passengers are confirmed yet, so the total margin depends on how many choose a single room. These are the two extremes.
prices.impactDouble: The shared-room cost goes from {before} to {after}
prices.impactSingle: The single-room cost goes from {before} to {after}
prices.negativeMargin: This price is below cost: you'd lose {amount} per passenger.
prices.activePlansWarning: {count, plural, one {# passenger already has a payment plan. Their plan will NOT change: they still owe what was set when it was created. The new price only applies to passengers without a plan yet.} other {# passengers already have payment plans. Their plans will NOT change: they still owe what was set when they were created. The new price only applies to passengers without a plan yet.}}
prices.depositHelp: Optional. Leave it empty and no deposit is requested.
prices.installmentCountHelp: Counting the deposit as the first one. The default is 3: deposit plus two.
prices.intervalMonthsHelp: Only used when there's a deposit. Without one, instalments are spread until departure.

detail.readOnly: This trip is completed: it can only be viewed.

step1.intro: Let's start with the basics. Copy the details exactly as they appear in your passport.
step1.roomTypeConfirmedNote: You're already confirmed. If you need to change this, ask your coordinator.
step1.languageHelp: We'll write to you in this language.
step1.fullNameHelp: As it appears in your passport.
step1.mobilePhoneHelp: Include the country code, for example +44 7700 900123.
step1.passportIssuingCountryHelp: It may not match your nationality, if you hold more than one citizenship.

step2.intro: We only use this if something happens. The more complete, the better.
step2.emergencyContactNameHelp: Someone staying at home we can call.
step2.hasMobilityRestrictionsHelp: So we can arrange transfers and choose the right visits.
step2.emergencyContactRelationshipHelp: Mother, partner, sister. So we know who we're speaking to if we have to call.
step2.takesMedicationHelp: So we have it to hand if it's ever needed.

step2.mentalHealthWhoSees: Only the trip coordinators see this. It never appears in any spreadsheet, never goes in any email, and no other passenger sees it.
step2.psychTreatment: I'm in psychological or psychiatric treatment
step2.psychTreatmentHelp: Optional. It helps us support you better.
step2.anxietyOrPanic: I have anxiety or panic episodes
step2.anxietyOrPanicHelp: Knowing helps us stay attentive and not push situations.
step2.additionalInfo: Anything else you'd like to tell us
step2.additionalInfoHelp: Optional. Whatever didn't fit in any field.
